svg.desc: OpenBridge Tank (OpenBridge obc-automation-tank, Apache-2.0). Bindable properties: _pn_level (default 50): Level (same unit as max) _pn_max (default 100): Maximum level _ps_trend (default 'stable'): fast-rising | rising | stable | falling | fast-falling _ps_medium (default 'water'): water | air | normal | empty _ps_tag (default 'T-101'): Tank tag label
